geo.description: Legacy common option. Not forwarded by the HTML adapter or recognized by the current browser runtime. Do not rely on it to customize execution.

render.description: For scrape, true or an object selects browser runtime. Nested wait/timeout settings are not runtime settings: use top-level timeoutMs and waitUntil. Browser runtime does not support credit caps.

maxCredits.description: Additional task credit cap. External AI provider costs are excluded.

allowFallback.description: Set false to restrict fallback. General estimation includes fallback unless false; quickstart forces false.

taskId.description: Shared task budget identifier within the workspace. Use a new ID per logical run; distinct from idempotency.

costControl.description: Supported on compatible scrape/map/crawl/extract, independent collection engine and current search paths. Legacy browser runtime/interact and V2 watch creation reject credit caps. External AI costs excluded.

metadata.description: Accepted configuration metadata is not included in the current delivered event payload.

Webhook.description: See https://deepsfetch.com/docs/webhooks for HMAC verification and delivery limitations. No automatic webhook retry in the current delivery chain.

formats.description: Use html/markdown on the HTML path. render or screenshot routes to browser runtime supporting html/markdown/links/screenshot. json is a legacy accepted value without implemented JSON extraction.

jsonSchema.description: Legacy field; structured JSON generation is not implemented by the current scrape adapter/runtime. Use extract or validated templates.

collectionEngine.description: Opt in to the independent 1-credit engine. Basic and browser retries included. Premium requires a prior failed offer and explicit 12-credit approval.

scrapeResults.description: Use /v2/scrape separately. Combined search and scraping is not supported.

category.description: Domain allowlist for Web results; use general with News or Images. No additional DeepSFetch credits.

limit.description: Effective adapter maximum: 500. Higher values fail with provider_limit_exceeded.

actions.description: Effective browser runtime limit is 20 actions.

schedule.description: Minute interval only, e.g. 15m, 1min or 60m; 1–525600 minutes. Cron expressions are unsupported.

changeThreshold.description: Accepted legacy field, ignored by the current adapter. Text and HTML use a fixed change policy.

result.description: Provider-specific output. V1 adapter: provider, operation, providerJobId, status, statusUrl, result, meta. Inspect inner status for partial completion; browser shape differs.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL; no credentials, IP literal or custom port.

maxCredits.description: Additional task credit cap. External AI provider costs are excluded.

allowFallback.description: Set false to restrict fallback. General estimation includes fallback unless false; quickstart forces false.

taskId.description: Shared task budget identifier within the workspace. Use a new ID per logical run; distinct from idempotency.

costControl.description: Supported on compatible scrape/map/crawl/extract paths. Browser runtime, interact, search and watch reject caps (including workspace policy) with 409 cost_operation_unsupported. External AI costs excluded.

result.description: Template-specific validated result; check valid before consumption.
